findings.evidence:
SAME-PAGE TOTAL DIVERGENCE between two SSOTs on the wizard recap. State 05 (Salade Royale item_id=393, menu=frites, Cheddar+Oignons extra_id=906) renders BOTH: (a) `€11,30` inside the canonical order-summary card (CORRECT: base 7.50 + menu addon 1.80 + Cheddar+Oignons 2.00 = 11.30€, matches payload sidecar `post_addToCart.cartItems[item_id=393].total === 11.3`); AND (b) `
Total €12,50
` in the bottom-bar (WRONG by +1.20€). State 12 (Filets 6 pcs item_id=398, same combo) reproduces IDENTICALLY: summary-aria='Total €11,30' vs nav='Total €12,50' — same +1.20€ overstatement. State 04 + state 11 (frites_style step BEFORE picking the extra) show nav='Total €10,50' while expected is 7.50+1.80=9.30 — confirms the +1.20€ overstatement is introduced as soon as menuChoice='frites' is set, independent of the Cheddar+Oignons extra. Per category 11 numeric_integrity: 'same fact differs across N surfaces' → P0. AJOUTER AU PANIER button uses the canonical 11.30€ (payload sidecar proves cart line.total is correctly 11.30), so the bug is presentation-layer in `.kiosk-nav-total` binding; but a customer staring at two contradictory totals on the same page is a P0 trust defect and a fiscal-perception risk (customer believes they will be charged 12.50 then sees 11.30 elsewhere). Flip-to-none baselines pass (state 08 nav 7,50 = summary 7,50; state 14 nav 6,00 = summary 6,00), proving the bug is gated on menuChoice='frites'.

findings.fix_hint: Two-pronged: (1) `resources/js/components/frontend/kiosk/KioskWizardComponent.vue` or analytics helper — debounce /api/frontend/kiosk-event POSTs to max 1/sec per (step, item) to avoid rate-limit pressure during normal user navigation. (2) Tune the rate limiter in `app/Http/Controllers/Frontend/KioskEventController.php` (or the route's `throttle:` middleware) to a kiosk-friendly ceiling. (3) Spec pacing: insert `await page.waitForTimeout(200)` between rapid menu-card clicks in `test-e2e-borne-C.spec.ts` to mimic realistic user tempo.
